meanings.en: the quality of being impressive or magnificent in size or appearance
meanings.exampleEn: We were struck by the grandeur of the mountains.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağların ihtişamı karşısında etkilendik.

meanings.en: the quality of being splendid or high in rank
meanings.exampleEn: The palace was built to reflect the grandeur of the king.
meanings.exampleTr: Saray, kralın azametini yansıtmak için inşa edilmişti.

meanings.en: the quality of being noble or elevated in character or style
meanings.exampleEn: The loftiness of her ideals inspired everyone around her.
meanings.exampleTr: İdeallerinin yüceliği çevresindeki herkese ilham verdi.

meanings.en: an attitude of superiority or arrogance
meanings.exampleEn: His loftiness made it hard for colleagues to approach him.
meanings.exampleTr: Tepeden bakan tavrı, meslektaşlarının ona yaklaşmasını zorlaştırdı.

meanings.en: a short period of rest or relief from something difficult or unpleasant
meanings.exampleEn: The cool evening brought a welcome respite from the heat.
meanings.exampleTr: Serin akşam, sıcaktan hoş bir dinlenme fırsatı getirdi.

meanings.en: to do something to show you are sorry for a wrong you have done
meanings.exampleEn: He spent years trying to atone for his past mistakes.
meanings.exampleTr: Geçmiş hatalarının kefaretini ödemek için yıllarca uğraştı.

meanings.en: relating to or affected by cancer
meanings.exampleEn: The doctors removed the cancerous cells during surgery.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktorlar ameliyat sırasında kanserli hücreleri aldılar.

meanings.en: the state of being married
meanings.exampleEn: The couple were joined in holy wedlock.
meanings.exampleTr: Çift kutsal evlilik bağıyla birleşti.

meanings.en: the state of being fully grown and ready to be eaten or used
meanings.exampleEn: You can tell the ripeness of a melon by its smell.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir kavunun olgunluğunu kokusundan anlayabilirsin.

meanings.en: the state of not being fully developed or behaving in a childish way
meanings.exampleEn: His immaturity showed in the way he handled criticism.
meanings.exampleTr: Eleştiriyi ele alış biçimi olgunlaşmamışlığını gösteriyordu.

meanings.en: a bush with sweet-smelling purple or white flowers
meanings.exampleEn: The garden was filled with the scent of lilac in spring.
meanings.exampleTr: Bahçe ilkbaharda leylak kokusuyla dolmuştu.

meanings.en: a pale purple color
meanings.exampleEn: She wore a dress in a soft shade of lilac.
meanings.exampleTr: Yumuşak bir leylak tonunda bir elbise giymişti.

meanings.en: very small or insignificant in amount
meanings.exampleEn: They offered him a paltry sum for all his hard work.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm emeği için ona cüzi bir miktar teklif ettiler.

meanings.en: able to be measured or expressed as a number or amount
meanings.exampleEn: The benefits of the project are not easily quantifiable.
meanings.exampleTr: Projenin faydaları kolayca ölçülebilir değil.

meanings.en: able to be evaluated, judged, or estimated
meanings.exampleEn: Student progress should be clearly assessable at each stage.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğrenci ilerlemesi her aşamada açıkça değerlendirilebilir olmalı.

meanings.en: too large or extreme to be measured
meanings.exampleEn: Her contribution to the company was of immeasurable value.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirkete katkısı ölçülemez değerdeydi.

meanings.tr: kentsel yığın, birleşik büyük şehir bölgesi
meanings.en: a large area consisting of several towns that have grown together
meanings.exampleEn: London is part of a vast conurbation in southeast England.
meanings.exampleTr: Londra, İngiltere'nin güneydoğusundaki geniş bir kentsel yığının parçasıdır.

meanings.en: the act of remembering or an account of something remembered from the past
meanings.exampleEn: The old man shared his reminiscences of the war.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaşlı adam savaşa dair anılarını paylaştı.

meanings.en: having or showing no pity or compassion for others
meanings.exampleEn: She was ruthless in her pursuit of power.
meanings.exampleTr: İktidar peşinde koşarken acımasızdı.

meanings.en: continuing without stopping and without becoming less intense
meanings.exampleEn: The relentless pressure of deadlines began to wear him down.
meanings.exampleTr: Teslim tarihlerinin amansız baskısı onu yıpratmaya başladı.

meanings.en: harsh and refusing to give up or show mercy
meanings.exampleEn: He was relentless in his criticism of the plan.
meanings.exampleTr: Planı eleştirirken tavizsizdi.

meanings.en: lively and noisy festivities or celebration
meanings.exampleEn: The streets were full of revelry during the festival.
meanings.exampleTr: Festival sırasında sokaklar cümbüşle doluydu.

meanings.en: holding your complete attention as if by magic
meanings.exampleEn: The actor gave a spellbinding performance on stage.
meanings.exampleTr: Oyuncu sahnede büyüleyici bir performans sergiledi.

meanings.en: so interesting or exciting that it holds your attention completely
meanings.exampleEn: The novel was so enthralling that I read it in one night.
meanings.exampleTr: Roman o kadar sürükleyiciydi ki bir gecede okudum.

meanings.en: to crush something into small pieces or powder
meanings.exampleEn: She likes to grind fresh coffee beans every morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Her sabah taze kahve çekirdeklerini öğütmeyi sever.

meanings.en: to make something sharp or smooth by rubbing on a hard surface
meanings.exampleEn: He used a stone to grind the blade to a sharp edge.
meanings.exampleTr: Bıçağı keskinleştirmek için bir taş kullandı.

meanings.tr: azami düzeye çıkarma, en üst düzeye getirme
meanings.en: the act of making something as large or great as possible
meanings.exampleEn: The firm focused on the maximisation of shareholder profit.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, hissedar kârının en üst düzeye çıkarılmasına odaklandı.

meanings.en: a difficult, complicated situation that is hard to escape from
meanings.exampleEn: The company found itself in a legal quagmire.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket kendini hukuki bir çıkmazda buldu.

meanings.en: an area of soft, wet ground that is hard to walk on
meanings.exampleEn: The heavy rain turned the field into a quagmire.
meanings.exampleTr: Şiddetli yağmur tarlayı bir bataklığa çevirdi.

meanings.en: careless, wrong, or illegal behavior by a professional in their work
meanings.exampleEn: The doctor was sued for medical malpractice.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktor, tıbbi hata nedeniyle dava edildi.

meanings.en: in an extremely unhappy, unpleasant, or poor way
meanings.exampleEn: They lived wretchedly in a cold, damp room.
meanings.exampleTr: Soğuk, nemli bir odada sefil bir şekilde yaşıyorlardı.

meanings.en: the act of managing something badly or carelessly
meanings.exampleEn: The company's collapse was blamed on financial mismanagement.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirketin çöküşü mali kötü yönetime bağlandı.

meanings.en: not suitable for each other or not well combined
meanings.exampleEn: They were an ill-matched couple who argued constantly.
meanings.exampleTr: Sürekli tartışan, birbirine uymayan bir çifttiler.

meanings.en: bad or dishonest government of a country or organization
meanings.exampleEn: Years of misgovernment left the nation in poverty.
meanings.exampleTr: Yıllar süren kötü yönetim ulusu yoksulluğa sürükledi.

meanings.en: to make a long, low sound expressing pain, unhappiness, or annoyance
meanings.exampleEn: He began to groan with pain as he tried to stand up.
meanings.exampleTr: Ayağa kalkmaya çalışırken acıyla inlemeye başladı.

meanings.en: the first version of a product from which others are developed
meanings.exampleEn: The engineers built a working prototype of the new engine.
meanings.exampleTr: Mühendisler yeni motorun çalışan bir prototipini yaptılar.

meanings.en: a model of a human body used to display clothes or in tests
meanings.exampleEn: The shop window featured a dummy wearing the latest fashion.
meanings.exampleTr: Mağaza vitrininde son moda giysiler giymiş bir manken vardı.

meanings.en: an object made to look like a real one but not functional
meanings.exampleEn: The security camera was just a dummy to scare off thieves.
meanings.exampleTr: Güvenlik kamerası, hırsızları korkutmak için konulmuş sahte bir modeldi.

meanings.en: involving doing or saying the same thing many times, often in a boring way
meanings.exampleEn: The job was so repetitive that she quickly grew bored.
meanings.exampleTr: İş o kadar tekrar eden bir yapıdaydı ki çabucak sıkıldı.

meanings.en: an untidy mixture of things without any order
meanings.exampleEn: Her desk was a jumble of papers and old coffee cups.
meanings.exampleTr: Masası kağıtların ve eski kahve fincanlarının karmakarışık bir yığınıydı.

meanings.en: having many different aspects, qualities, or abilities
meanings.exampleEn: The problem is many-sided and requires careful thought.
meanings.exampleTr: Sorun çok yönlüdür ve dikkatli düşünmeyi gerektirir.

meanings.en: lacking depth or considering only one aspect of something
meanings.exampleEn: The critics said the film's characters were one-dimensional.
meanings.exampleTr: Eleştirmenler filmin karakterlerinin tek boyutlu olduğunu söyledi.

meanings.en: a person who knows and can use several languages
meanings.exampleEn: As a polyglot, she could switch easily between five languages.
meanings.exampleTr: Çok dil bilen biri olarak beş dil arasında kolayca geçiş yapabiliyordu.

meanings.en: the highest or most successful point of something
meanings.exampleEn: The empire reached its zenith in the sixteenth century.
meanings.exampleTr: İmparatorluk on altıncı yüzyılda zirvesine ulaştı.

meanings.en: the state of not being guilty of a crime
meanings.exampleEn: The lawyer was determined to prove his client's innocence.
meanings.exampleTr: Avukat, müvekkilinin masumiyetini kanıtlamaya kararlıydı.

meanings.en: the state of being pure and free of experience of evil
meanings.exampleEn: There was a certain innocence in the child's questions.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuğun sorularında belli bir saflık vardı.

meanings.tr: saflık, kolay kanma, her söylenene inanma
meanings.en: the tendency to believe things too easily and be deceived
meanings.exampleEn: Scammers took advantage of the elderly man's gullibility.
meanings.exampleTr: Dolandırıcılar yaşlı adamın saflığından yararlandı.

meanings.en: not made by a well-known company; not famous
meanings.exampleEn: He saved money by buying no-name brands at the supermarket.
meanings.exampleTr: Süpermarketten markasız ürünler alarak para biriktirdi.

meanings.en: the activity of telling or writing stories
meanings.exampleEn: Good storytelling can make a presentation far more memorable.
meanings.exampleTr: İyi bir hikaye anlatıcılığı bir sunumu çok daha akılda kalıcı yapabilir.

meanings.en: willing to accept opinions and behavior different from your own
meanings.exampleEn: Her parents were broad-minded about her career choices.
meanings.exampleTr: Ailesi kariyer seçimleri konusunda açık fikirliydi.

meanings.en: the quality of being firmly fixed, stretched, or fitting closely
meanings.exampleEn: He felt a tightness in his chest after running.
meanings.exampleTr: Koştuktan sonra göğsünde bir sıkışma hissetti.

meanings.en: the quality or state of being old
meanings.exampleEn: The oldness of the building gave it a certain charm.
meanings.exampleTr: Binanın eskiliği ona belli bir çekicilik katıyordu.

meanings.en: clothes that are worn in bed
meanings.exampleEn: The store has a wide range of comfortable sleepwear.
meanings.exampleTr: Mağazada geniş bir rahat gece kıyafeti yelpazesi var.
